title: Jordan Hospital — Doctors directory and hospital details
notes: Doctors from window.JH_DOCTORS in assets/js/doctors-data.js (195 entries = AR+EN translations of the same doctor, merged via the translations map into 100 practitioners; 5 EN entries have no AR twin). English names/descriptors look machine-translated (e.g. "Dr. Al-Zahlaf Symposium", "Bone and joint comfort") - prefer name_ar. EN trid 2210 "Dr. Anwar Ahmed Jarad" is an empty duplicate of 2097. grade derived only when the descriptor text says Consultant/استشاري or Specialist/أخصائي. No schedules or fees published. robots.txt returns 404 (no restrictions); terms page has no scraping prohibition. Facility equipment from homepage copy (3T MRI, CT, cath unit); no bed count, no accreditation and no insurer names published on the current site.
